name: @agentic-toolkit/adh-products
description: The Products feature: @agentic-toolkit/ecosystems presented as Products, with its topic rail and the panes each topic opens.
comment:tier: VOCABULARY, not mechanism — see scripts/check_boundaries.py. This package composes @agentic-toolkit/adh-ecosystem-panes and @agentic-toolkit/adh's help store, both of which are vocabulary, so it must carry the `adh-` prefix to sit on the right side of the guard's line. That is not incidental: the whole point of this package is a HUB CONCEPT (a Product is what adh calls an ecosystem, with adh's own topic rail on it), not the ecosystem machinery — which stays in @agentic-toolkit/ecosystems, mechanism, where a non-adh host can still mount it. The directory is `features/` only because the tsup/vitest presets live there.
comment:exports: see @agentic-toolkit/adh for the full rationale. The barrel is `use client` (the feature composes client panes) and tsup hoists that directive over the chunk, so the topic RAIL — plain data — gets its own directive-free entry, the same split the tsup preset describes for ./parse and ./tables. Its consumer is any host that wants a product topic's id or label without mounting the feature.
